After live update, there is ONLY Invite Group button.

Still missing the Join Group button. Some friends even agreed with me.

The way to join the group is just too much work and not user-friendly at all:

- you need remember the name

- you can't look at group name while UI menu is up (unless you have overlay, then you can use website for it - but most players have no overlay)

- type name EXACTLY in keyboard

- and finally join group.

All that work can done with join button. You can ofc only join the represented name above player.

When will it added? Not all players are smart or can remember well, or are good with menu system...

details:
Here is kinda important feature request. When i asked friends to join my group, i noticed they need first SEARCH for my group, on website, and IF they can find me, they can join my group.

I am looking in the quick player menu (the page where will show up if you click on the player) and i see the button for add Friend Request, but there is no button for join group...

Right now, it's long process for website:

- open menu so group banner will more visible on player ingame, and i can see the code for group (NAME.1234)

- type the code in search field group

- hope it can find it, then click on it

- finally, join the group button

The first steps are hardest because not all players have overlay. So... you need write down the group name, because you can't make photo of it (it will just close banner name).

So... a button to join group will save a lot work for it. The button can only join the represented banner on the player, not other banners the player also joined.

That is it. If there are more groups, might show the list of connected groups on the player but that is more asked for just a button.

If we can ask for friends request, we must have chance to join the group easy if possible, instead try remember name and search for it, which is so much work for some people.

Please add Join Group button in the player page. Thank you.
title: [VRC Group] Need Join Group button ingame.
